description: This file defines a plugin class `RangeRequestsPlugin` for handling HTTP range requests within the Workbox library. It intercepts cached responses and returns partial responses based on the request's Range header, facilitating efficient partial content loading.

classes.name: RangeRequestsPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for handling HTTP Range requests by returning partial cached responses.

methods.name: constructor()
methods.description: Initializes the plugin instance with a method `cachedResponseWillBeUsed` that processes requests to serve partial responses if needed.

methods.name: cachedResponseWillBeUsed
methods.description: Intercepts the response fetch process; if a Range header is present, returns a sliced partial response, otherwise the full cached response.
